    def _edits(self, user, history):
        n = len(history)
        yield "identity", 0, history, 0, "retained"
        if n < 2:
            return
        k = min(3, max(1, n // 5), n - 1)
        yield "recent_removal", 0, history[:-k], k, "removed"
        yield "old_removal", 0, history[k:], k, "retained"
        yield "last_item_only", 0, history[-1:], n - 1, "retained"
        preserved_k = min(k, n - 2)
        if preserved_k:
            yield "preanchor_removal", 0, history[: n - 1 - preserved_k] + history[
                -1:
            ], preserved_k, "retained"
            yield "early_anchor_preserved", 0, history[
                preserved_k:
            ], preserved_k, "retained"
        for draw in range(self.settings["draws"]):
            rng = random.Random(self._seed(user, "random_deletion", draw))
            removed = set(rng.sample(range(n), k))
            edited = tuple(item for i, item in enumerate(history) if i not in removed)
            yield "random_deletion", draw, edited, k, (
                "removed" if n - 1 in removed else "retained"
            )
            for name, fixed in (("shuffle", False), ("prefix_shuffle", True)):
                rng = random.Random(self._seed(user, name, draw))
                prefix = list(history[:-1] if fixed else history)
                rng.shuffle(prefix)
                edited = tuple(prefix) + (history[-1:] if fixed else ())
                yield name, draw, edited, 0, "retained" if fixed else "unrestricted"

    def _matched_contrasts(self, records):
        """Paired effects, using identical users and complete stochastic draws."""
        comparisons = (
            ("recent_minus_old", "recent_removal", "old_removal"),
            ("preanchor_minus_early", "preanchor_removal", "early_anchor_preserved"),
            ("shuffle_minus_prefix_shuffle", "shuffle", "prefix_shuffle"),
        )
        fields = (
            "top10_overlap",
            "top10_mean_absolute_rank_displacement",
            "strict_pair_flip_rate",
            "raw_mean_absolute_score_change",
            "feature_l2_change",
        )
        result = {}
        users = sorted({row["user"] for row in records})
        for name, left, right in comparisons:
            expected = self.settings["draws"] if left == "shuffle" else 1
            expected_ids = set(range(expected))
            paired, excluded = [], []
            for user in users:
                a = [r for r in records if r["user"] == user and r["edit"] == left]
                b = [r for r in records if r["user"] == user and r["edit"] == right]
                if (
                    len(a) != expected
                    or len(b) != expected
                    or {r["draw"] for r in a} != expected_ids
                    or {r["draw"] for r in b} != expected_ids
                ):
                    excluded.append(user)
                    continue
                row = {"user": user, "edit": name, "no_op": False}
                for field in fields:
                    av, bv = [r[field] for r in a], [r[field] for r in b]
                    row[field] = (
                        float(np.mean(av) - np.mean(bv))
                        if all(v is not None for v in av + bv)
                        else None
                    )
                paired.append(row)
            summary = self._aggregate(paired).get(name, {})
            summary.update(
                {
                    "direction": f"{left} minus {right}",
                    "paired_user_ids": [r["user"] for r in paired],
                    "excluded_incomplete_or_ineligible_user_ids": excluded,
                    "interpretation": (
                        "Difference in frozen-input sensitivity, not an accuracy effect. "
                        "Recent/old removal differ in final-item policy; preanchor/early "
                        "both preserve the anchor. Shuffle conditions differ in whether "
                        "the final slot is fixed. Compaction also changes positions."
                    ),
                }
            )
            result[name] = summary
        return result

    def _replacement_audit(self, snapshot, panel):
        """Plan matches before scoring; never relax calipers after observing effects."""
        frequency = np.zeros(self.itemnum + 1, dtype=np.float64)
        transitions = {}
        for history in snapshot.values():
            np.add.at(frequency, np.asarray(history, dtype=np.int64), 1)
            for a, b in zip(history, history[1:]):
                transitions.setdefault(a, Counter())[b] += 1
        catalog = np.flatnonzero(frequency > 0)
        if not len(catalog):
            return {"status": "empty_training_catalog"}
        prior = frequency / frequency.sum()
        logpop = np.log1p(frequency)
        pop_sd = float(logpop[catalog].std())
        text, text_status = None, "unavailable"
        try:
            from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
            metadata = {str(k): v for k, v in (self.view.meta_data or {}).items()}
            documents = []
            for item in catalog:
                entry = metadata.get(str(item), {})
                parts = []
                for field in ("title", "description"):
                    value = entry.get(field)
                    if isinstance(value, str):
                        parts.append(value)
                    elif isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
                        parts.extend(v for v in value if isinstance(v, str))
                documents.append(" ".join(parts))
            text = TfidfVectorizer(lowercase=True, ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=2,
                                   max_features=50000, norm="l2").fit_transform(documents)
            text_status = "training_catalog_titles_descriptions_only"
        except (AttributeError, TypeError, ValueError, ImportError) as error:
            text_status = "unavailable: " + str(error)
        locations = {int(item): i for i, item in enumerate(catalog)}
        plans, rows, contrasts, failures, audits, controls = [], [], [], [], {}, {}
        fields = ("top10_overlap", "top10_mean_absolute_rank_displacement",
                  "strict_pair_flip_rate", "raw_mean_absolute_score_change", "feature_l2_change")

        def incoming(predecessor):
            raw = transitions.get(predecessor, Counter())
            counts = np.fromiter((raw.get(int(j), 0) for j in catalog), float, len(catalog))
            probability = (counts + 10.0 * prior[catalog]) / (sum(raw.values()) + 10.0)
            return np.log(probability), counts

        for user in panel:
            full = snapshot.get(user, ())
            history = full[-self.maxlen:]
            if not history:
                failures.append({"user": user, "reason": "missing_or_empty_history"})
                continue
            candidates = np.setdiff1d(np.arange(1, self.itemnum + 1), full)
            eligible = ~np.isin(catalog, full)
            selected = []
            n = len(history)
            split = (n - 1) // 2
            for seed in self.settings["replacement_draw_seeds"]:
                rng = random.Random(self._seed(user, "replacement", seed))
                strata = [("final", [n - 1])]
                if split and n - 1 - split:
                    strata.insert(0, ("paired", [rng.randrange(split, n - 1), rng.randrange(split)]))
                else:
                    failures.append({"user": user, "draw": seed, "reason": "no_two_nonfinal_regions"})
                for stratum, positions in strata:
                    feasible, details, similarities = eligible.copy(), [], []
                    for position in positions:
                        displaced = history[position]
                        predecessor = history[position - 1] if position else None
                        lp, raw = incoming(predecessor)
                        sd = float(lp.std())
                        target_index = locations[displaced]
                        pop_delta = logpop[catalog] - logpop[displaced]
                        trans_delta = lp - lp[target_index]
                        feasible &= np.abs(pop_delta) <= 0.5 * pop_sd
                        feasible &= np.abs(trans_delta) <= 0.5 * sd
                        cosine = None
                        if text is not None and text[target_index].nnz:
                            cosine = (text @ text[target_index].T).toarray().ravel()
                        similarities.append(cosine)
                        details.append((predecessor, pop_delta, trans_delta, sd, raw, target_index))
                    if len(similarities) == 2 and all(v is not None for v in similarities):
                        available = np.asarray(text.getnnz(axis=1)).ravel() > 0
                        feasible &= ~available | (np.abs(similarities[0] - similarities[1]) <= 0.1)
                    support = np.flatnonzero(feasible)
                    plan = {"user": user, "draw": seed, "stratum": stratum,
                            "feasible_donors": int(len(support)), "matched": bool(len(support))}
                    plans.append(plan)
                    if not len(support):
                        continue
                    index = int(support[rng.randrange(len(support))])
                    donor = int(catalog[index])
                    plan.update({"donor": donor, "edits": []})
                    for arm, position, detail, cosine in zip(
                        (["recent", "older"] if stratum == "paired" else ["final"]),
                        positions, details, similarities
                    ):
                        predecessor, pd, td, sd, raw, target_index = detail
                        detail_record = {"arm": arm, "position": self.maxlen - n + position,
                            "window_position": position, "displaced": history[position],
                            "predecessor": predecessor, "missing_predecessor": predecessor is None,
                            "log1p_frequency_delta": float(pd[index]),
                            "frequency_standardized_delta": float(pd[index] / pop_sd) if pop_sd else None,
                            "log_incoming_probability_delta": float(td[index]),
                            "transition_standardized_delta": float(td[index] / sd) if sd else None,
                            "displaced_transition_count": int(raw[target_index]),
                            "donor_transition_count": int(raw[index]),
                            "outgoing_transition_count": int(sum(transitions.get(predecessor, {}).values())),
                            "text_cosine": float(cosine[index]) if cosine is not None and text[index].nnz else None}
                        plan["edits"].append(detail_record)
                    selected.append(plan)
            donors = sorted({p["donor"] for p in selected})
            for pool_name, pool in (("C", candidates), ("C_minus", np.setdiff1d(candidates, donors))):
                if not len(pool):
                    failures.append({"user": user, "pool": pool_name, "reason": "empty_pool"})
                    continue
                try:
                    feature = self._features(history)
                    original = self._scores(feature, pool)
                    repeated_feature = self._features(history)
                    repeated = self._scores(repeated_feature, pool)
                    identity = list(history)
                    identity[-1] = history[-1]
                    identity_feature = self._features(tuple(identity))
                    identity_scores = self._scores(identity_feature, pool)
                    order, ranks = self._ranks(original)
                    audit = {"repeated_scores_close": bool(np.allclose(original, repeated, rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-6)),
                             "identity_scores_close": bool(np.allclose(original, identity_scores, rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-6)),
                             "identity_features_close": bool(torch.allclose(feature, identity_feature, rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-6)),
                             "repeated_ranks_equal": bool(np.array_equal(order, self._ranks(repeated)[0])),
                             "identity_ranks_equal": bool(np.array_equal(order, self._ranks(identity_scores)[0])),
                             "positive_rescaling_rank_invariant": bool(np.array_equal(order, self._ranks(2 * original)[0]))}
                    audits[user + ":" + pool_name] = audit
                    if not all(audit.values()):
                        raise ValueError("Identity/repeated-inference/rescaling audit failed")
                    pairs = self._pairs(user + ":" + pool_name, len(pool))
                    for plan in selected:
                        arm_rows = {}
                        try:
                            for edit in plan["edits"]:
                                changed_history = list(history)
                                changed_history[edit["window_position"]] = plan["donor"]
                                changed_feature = self._features(tuple(changed_history))
                                changed = self._scores(changed_feature, pool)
                                stats, _, changed_ranks = self._statistics(original, changed, pairs)
                                stats.update({"user": user, "draw": plan["draw"], "no_op": False,
                                    "edit": pool_name + ":" + edit["arm"],
                                    "feature_l2_change": float((changed_feature - feature).norm()),
                                    "donor": plan["donor"], "position": edit["position"]})
                                if pool_name == "C":
                                    index = int(np.searchsorted(pool, plan["donor"]))
                                    stats["donor_score_change"] = float(changed[index] - original[index])
                                    stats["donor_rank_change"] = int(changed_ranks[index] - ranks[index])
                                    stats["donor_entered_top10"] = bool(ranks[index] >= 10 and changed_ranks[index] < 10)
                                arm_rows[edit["arm"]] = stats
                            rows.extend(arm_rows.values())
                            if plan["stratum"] == "paired":
                                a, b = arm_rows["recent"], arm_rows["older"]
                                contrast = {"user": user, "draw": plan["draw"], "no_op": False,
                                            "edit": pool_name + ":recent_minus_older"}
                                contrast.update({f: a[f] - b[f] if a[f] is not None and b[f] is not None else None for f in fields})
                                contrasts.append(contrast)
                        except (ValueError, RuntimeError) as error:
                            failures.append({"user": user, "pool": pool_name, "draw": plan["draw"],
                                             "stratum": plan["stratum"], "error": str(error)})
                    if pool_name == "C":
                        last_lp, _ = incoming(history[-1])
                        transition_score = np.zeros(self.itemnum + 1)
                        transition_score[catalog] = np.exp(last_lp)
                        weighted = np.zeros(self.itemnum + 1)
                        weights = np.exp2(-np.arange(n - 1, -1, -1) / 10.0)
                        weights /= weights.sum()
                        for item, weight in zip(history, weights):
                            lp, _ = incoming(item)
                            weighted[catalog] += weight * np.exp(lp)
                        controls[user] = {}
                        for name, score in (("popularity", prior), ("last_transition", transition_score), ("recency_pairwise", weighted)):
                            stats, control_order, _ = self._statistics(original, score[pool], pairs)
                            controls[user][name] = {**stats, "top10": pool[control_order[:10]].tolist()}
                except (ValueError, RuntimeError) as error:
                    failures.append({"user": user, "pool": pool_name, "error": str(error)})
        combined = rows + contrasts
        users = sorted({r["user"] for r in combined})
        return {"status": "observational_training_only", "match_plans": plans,
            "matched_plans": sum(p["matched"] for p in plans), "attempted_plans": len(plans),
            "unmatched_fraction": float(np.mean([not p["matched"] for p in plans])) if plans else None,
            "donor_reuse": dict(Counter((p["user"] + ":" + str(p["donor"])) for p in plans if p["matched"])),
            "matching_population": "observed training catalog; log1p interaction frequency; predecessor-specific log smoothed probability SD",
            "text_status": text_status, "records": rows, "paired_records": contrasts,
            "summary": self._aggregate(combined), "audits": audits, "failures": failures,
            "leave_one_user_out": {u: self._aggregate([r for r in combined if r["user"] != u]) for u in users},
            "training_behavioral_controls": controls,
            "limitations": "Same donor in separate fixed-slot edits; final-position effects separate. Missing predecessor is marked. Timestamps remain attached to slots, producing synthetic item/time pairs. Text is a matching association with item identity, not model word use. Summaries condition on successful fixed matches; no rematching or training-seed uncertainty. Five users/category and sparse overlap limit conclusions. Aggregate four complete category means externally with equal weights; no accuracy improvement is claimed."}
